infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app needs access to your camera to take photos of safety documentation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app needs access to your photo library to upload safety documentation.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This app needs your location to record clock in/out times at construction sites.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow VanGuard to use your location to confirm you are on the job site when clocking in.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow VanGuard to use your camera for safety documents and site photos.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow VanGuard to access your photos for safety documents and site photos.
